sourceTitle: Pixel 10 with Gemini Intelligence, custom widgets, and more in our November Pixel Drop
originalTitle: Pixel 10 with Gemini Intelligence, custom widgets, and more in our November Pixel Drop
author: Mayra Fajardo

blocks.text: Our November Pixel Drop is here, with new and expanded features making your Pixel devices more personalized, intuitive, and handy. See how we’re bringing smarter automation, next-level personalization, and upgraded connectivity to your favorite devices. Updates start rolling out today and will continue over the next several weeks.
blocks.zh: 我们的11月像素滴在这里,有了新的和扩展的特性 让你的像素设备更个性化,直觉,和帮助。看看我们是如何带来更聪明的自动化,下一级个性化,并升级到您最喜欢的设备的连接 。更新工作今天开始展开,并将在今后几周内继续进行。
blocks.en: Our November Pixel Drop is here, with new and expanded features making your Pixel devices more personalized, intuitive, and handy. See how we’re bringing smarter automation, next-level personalization, and upgraded connectivity to your favorite devices. Updates start rolling out today and will continue over the next several weeks.

blocks.text: Use Pixel 10 with Gemini Intelligence
blocks.zh: 使用双子智能的像素 10
blocks.en: Use Pixel 10 with Gemini Intelligence

blocks.text: Gemini Intelligence is now available on Pixel 10 devices, bringing new capabilities like Rambler, personalized suggestions, and taking care of multi-step tasks — like placing your morning coffee order.
blocks.zh: Gemini情报系统现在在像素10设备上带来新的能力 像拉姆布勒,个性化建议,并负责多步骤的任务——比如安排早晨的咖啡订单.
blocks.en: Gemini Intelligence is now available on Pixel 10 devices, bringing new capabilities like Rambler, personalized suggestions, and taking care of multi-step tasks — like placing your morning coffee order.

blocks.text: Polish your messages with Rambler on Pixel 10: Voice typing just got a major upgrade. Rambler can automatically remove filler words like “um,” and format your thoughts into clear, polished text. Just speak naturally, review, and send.
blocks.zh: 在像素10上给拉姆布勒留言波兰语:语音打字刚刚得到重大升级.Rambler可以自动删除填充词,如“um,” 将你的想法格式化为清晰,抛光文字.说得自然点审查,并发送。
blocks.en: Polish your messages with Rambler on Pixel 10: Voice typing just got a major upgrade. Rambler can automatically remove filler words like “um,” and format your thoughts into clear, polished text. Just speak naturally, review, and send.

blocks.text: Complete multi-step tasks with Gemini: Whether you’re getting groceries, booking a ride, ordering takeout, or trying to find a reservation at your favorite restaurant, let Gemini handle the logistics so you can focus on other tasks. Now available in Japan, UK, and India.
blocks.zh: 完成Gemini的多步任务 :无论你得到的杂货,预订一程,订购外卖,或者想在你最爱的餐厅订位让Gemini处理后勤工作 这样你就可以专注于其他任务了现在在日本可以使用,联合王国,(原始内容存档于2018-09-31). India.
blocks.en: Complete multi-step tasks with Gemini: Whether you’re getting groceries, booking a ride, ordering takeout, or trying to find a reservation at your favorite restaurant, let Gemini handle the logistics so you can focus on other tasks. Now available in Japan, UK, and India.

blocks.text: Receive proactive suggestions: From sharing your ETA with a tap when someone asks when you’ll arrive, to helping you find the perfect dinner spot, your Pixel anticipates what you need with timely information and suggested actions, so you can accomplish your daily tasks faster. 1 Also, coming soon to Pixel Watch 4.
blocks.zh: 接收主动建议:当有人问你何时会到来时,帮助你找到完美的晚餐地点,您的像素可以及时预知您需要的信息和建议行动,这样你就可以更快地完成日常任务。1 还有,即将来到像素观察4。
blocks.en: Receive proactive suggestions: From sharing your ETA with a tap when someone asks when you’ll arrive, to helping you find the perfect dinner spot, your Pixel anticipates what you need with timely information and suggested actions, so you can accomplish your daily tasks faster. 1 Also, coming soon to Pixel Watch 4.

blocks.text: Create more personalized widgets: Ever find yourself wanting a widget that doesn’t seem to exist? Create personalized widgets, like a tracker to follow your monthly spending, a game day widget with your team colors, or a getaway countdown that automatically pulls in flight and reservation details. Your home screen can be as personalized as you want it to be. Also, coming soon to Pixel Watch 4 and Pixel Watch 5. 2
blocks.zh: 创建更多个性化部件 :曾经发现自己想要一个似乎不存在的部件吗?创建个性化部件,就像跟踪你的月支出,包含团队颜色的游戏日部件,或逃跑倒计时 自动提取飞行和预留细节你家的屏幕可以像你想的那样个性化.还有,很快来到像素观察4号和像素观察5号.2个
blocks.en: Create more personalized widgets: Ever find yourself wanting a widget that doesn’t seem to exist? Create personalized widgets, like a tracker to follow your monthly spending, a game day widget with your team colors, or a getaway countdown that automatically pulls in flight and reservation details. Your home screen can be as personalized as you want it to be. Also, coming soon to Pixel Watch 4 and Pixel Watch 5. 2

blocks.text: Catch up on long conversations: Your Pixel can now provide summaries of your longer conversations, so you can see what’s important right away. Now available in German, French, Spanish, Italian, Hindi, and Traditional Chinese. Coming to Pixel Watches soon. 3
blocks.zh: 紧接着长话短说:您的像素现在可以提供 您更长的对话摘要,如此一来,你就能立刻看到什么是重要的东西。现在有德语版,法语西班牙语,意大利语,印地语和传统汉语.很快会到像素观察台的3个
blocks.en: Catch up on long conversations: Your Pixel can now provide summaries of your longer conversations, so you can see what’s important right away. Now available in German, French, Spanish, Italian, Hindi, and Traditional Chinese. Coming to Pixel Watches soon. 3

blocks.text: Call Screen got an upgrade on Pixel 11 series
blocks.zh: 调用屏幕在像素 11 系列上获得升级
blocks.en: Call Screen got an upgrade on Pixel 11 series

blocks.text: Whenever you see a call from an unknown number and choose to screen it, Gemini will ask unknown callers why they're reaching out in a much more conversational manner handling the exchange until you decide to jump in or end the call. With a live transcript displayed right on your screen, you can easily follow along and decide exactly when to pick up. Also, coming to Pixel Watch 4 and Pixel Watch 5 soon. 4
blocks.zh: 每当你看到一个未知号码的电话 并选择筛选它,Gemini会问未知的来电者,他们为什么要用更对话的方式进行交流,直到你决定跳跃或结束通话.在你的屏幕上 显示一个现场记录片你可以随身随从 并准确地决定什么时候接。还有,很快来到像素观察4和像素观察5。页:1
blocks.en: Whenever you see a call from an unknown number and choose to screen it, Gemini will ask unknown callers why they're reaching out in a much more conversational manner handling the exchange until you decide to jump in or end the call. With a live transcript displayed right on your screen, you can easily follow along and decide exactly when to pick up. Also, coming to Pixel Watch 4 and Pixel Watch 5 soon. 4

blocks.text: Personalize your Pixel with new custom icon styles
blocks.zh: 用新的自定义图标样式个性化您的像素
blocks.en: Personalize your Pixel with new custom icon styles

blocks.text: Following the launch of Custom Icons earlier this year, we’re adding more styles to give you even more ways to personalize your home screen Pixel. Pick from distinct styles that apply across all your app icons on the home screen. 5
blocks.zh: 继今年早些时候推出自定义图标后,让您家用屏幕像素更加个性化。从适用于您家用屏幕上所有应用程序图标的鲜明样式中选择 。页:1
blocks.en: Following the launch of Custom Icons earlier this year, we’re adding more styles to give you even more ways to personalize your home screen Pixel. Pick from distinct styles that apply across all your app icons on the home screen. 5

blocks.text: New updates coming to Pixel search
blocks.zh: 用于像素搜索的新更新
blocks.en: New updates coming to Pixel search

blocks.text: Now available on Pixel 6 and newer devices, Pixel search helps you find what you need across your phone – from vacation photos and recent emails to messages, calendar events, and device settings. 6
blocks.zh: 现在可以在像素6和新设备上找到,像素搜索帮助你找到手机上需要的东西 — 从度假照片和最近的邮件到留言,日历事件,和设备设置。6个
blocks.en: Now available on Pixel 6 and newer devices, Pixel search helps you find what you need across your phone – from vacation photos and recent emails to messages, calendar events, and device settings. 6

blocks.text: Stay in the moment with Google Messages and HiLight
blocks.zh: 与 Google Messages 和 HiLight 保持目前状态
blocks.en: Stay in the moment with Google Messages and HiLight

blocks.text: HiLight now supports Google Messages. When your phone is face down, HiLight will glow if you receive a message from one of your favorite contacts — letting you stay present without missing important messages or calls. 7
blocks.zh: 希莱特现在支持谷歌消息.当你的手机脸朝下,Hilight)会发光,如果你收到你最喜欢的联系人之一的留言——让你留在现场而不丢失重要留言或电话.第7条
blocks.en: HiLight now supports Google Messages. When your phone is face down, HiLight will glow if you receive a message from one of your favorite contacts — letting you stay present without missing important messages or calls. 7

blocks.text: Keep tabs on your belongings with Pixel Tag
blocks.zh: 用像素标记保存您的物品标签
blocks.en: Keep tabs on your belongings with Pixel Tag

blocks.text: Pixel Tag offers peace of mind so you always know where your most important things are — and it’s available November 11. It’s slim enough to fit in your wallet and durable enough to attach to your belongings, with a battery that lasts over a year. The Find Hub network of more than 1 billion Android devices helps you locate your belongings even if they are miles away and UWB enables visual direction and distance guidance to find it nearby. 8 Pixel Tag is available starting November 11 for $29.99 for one or $99.99 for a four-pack.
blocks.zh: Pixel Tag提供平静的心意,所以你总是知道你最重要的东西在哪里——11月11日可以使用.在你的钱包里,它足够瘦 足够耐久地附在你的财物上,电池持续了一年多超过10亿个Android设备的Find Hub网络帮助您找到自己的物品,即使这些物品离我们很远,而且UWB可以提供视觉方向和远程指导。在附近发现它。8像素标记自11月11日起可用,29.99美元为1美元,或99.99美元为4包.
blocks.en: Pixel Tag offers peace of mind so you always know where your most important things are — and it’s available November 11. It’s slim enough to fit in your wallet and durable enough to attach to your belongings, with a battery that lasts over a year. The Find Hub network of more than 1 billion Android devices helps you locate your belongings even if they are miles away and UWB enables visual direction and distance guidance to find it nearby. 8 Pixel Tag is available starting November 11 for $29.99 for one or $99.99 for a four-pack.

blocks.text: Switch between two of America's best 5G networks with Google Fi
blocks.zh: 用Google Fi在两个美国最好的5G网络之间切换
blocks.en: Switch between two of America's best 5G networks with Google Fi

blocks.text: Starting today on eligible Pixels, Google Fi’s new super network delivers the nation's fastest, most expansive coverage by automatically switching between two of America's top 5G cellular networks and millions of secure Wi-Fi networks. 9 10 11 12 Already have a Pixel but not using Google Fi? Get 50% off on select unlimited plans for 12 months. Ends 12/1/26. All terms apply. Visit the blog post, Google Fi website for details, and join Google Fi today.
blocks.zh: 从今天开始,从符合条件的像素,Google Fi的新超级网络为全国提供了最快的速度,最广的覆盖 通过自动切换 两个美国前5G蜂窝网络 和数百万安全无线网络。9 10 11 12 已经有一个像素 但没有使用 Google Fi?获得50%的豁免 选择无限计划 12个月。第12/1/26号结束。所有条件都适用。访问博客帖子,Google Fi网站详细信息,并加入Google Fi的今天。
blocks.en: Starting today on eligible Pixels, Google Fi’s new super network delivers the nation's fastest, most expansive coverage by automatically switching between two of America's top 5G cellular networks and millions of secure Wi-Fi networks. 9 10 11 12 Already have a Pixel but not using Google Fi? Get 50% off on select unlimited plans for 12 months. Ends 12/1/26. All terms apply. Visit the blog post, Google Fi website for details, and join Google Fi today.

blocks.text: Unlock your Pixel Watch with your phone
blocks.zh: 用手机解锁您的像素监视器
blocks.en: Unlock your Pixel Watch with your phone

blocks.text: Your Pixel devices work better together. When your watch is on your wrist and you’ve unlocked your nearby phone, your Pixel Watch will automatically unlock so you can skip typing your PIN or pattern on the watch. Coming in the next few weeks. 13
blocks.zh: 您的像素设备合作效果更好 。当你的手表放在手腕上,您的像素表将自动解锁, 这样您就可以跳过在表上的 PIN 或图案输入 。接下来几周就要来了13个
blocks.en: Your Pixel devices work better together. When your watch is on your wrist and you’ve unlocked your nearby phone, your Pixel Watch will automatically unlock so you can skip typing your PIN or pattern on the watch. Coming in the next few weeks. 13

blocks.text: Step-by-step workouts are rolling out to Pixel Watch
blocks.zh: 一步步的锻炼正在推出到像素监视器
blocks.en: Step-by-step workouts are rolling out to Pixel Watch

blocks.text: We’re now rolling out step-by-step workouts to Pixel Watch 3 and newer models. Whether you’re following an exercise routine created by your Google Health Coach 14 or a custom workout built in the Google Health app, you can get step-by-step instructions, log reps and weights, and track metrics directly from your Pixel Watch or your phone.
blocks.zh: 现在,我们正在逐步向Pixel Watch 3和较新的型号推广。无论是遵循您Google健康教练14 创建的练习程序, 还是在Google健康应用软件中构建的定制练习程序,你可以得到一步一步的指示,木材代表 和重量,直接从你的像素观察或手机中追踪测量值。
blocks.en: We’re now rolling out step-by-step workouts to Pixel Watch 3 and newer models. Whether you’re following an exercise routine created by your Google Health Coach 14 or a custom workout built in the Google Health app, you can get step-by-step instructions, log reps and weights, and track metrics directly from your Pixel Watch or your phone.

blocks.text: Check out our community forum post for the full list of new features arriving on your Pixel devices this month.
blocks.zh: 查看我们社区论坛的帖子 完整列表的新功能 到达您的像素设备 本月。
blocks.en: Check out our community forum post for the full list of new features arriving on your Pixel devices this month.
